steps.name: trivy-fs
steps.command: trivy fs --exit-code 1 --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --scanners vuln,secret,misconfig,license --skip-dirs artifacts --skip-dirs archive --skip-dirs _archive --skip-dirs .data --skip-dirs outputs --skip-dirs packs --skip-dirs node_modules --skip-dirs .venv --skip-dirs .pytest_cache --skip-dirs .ruff_cache --skip-dirs .mypy_cache --skip-dirs .nox --skip-dirs .tox --skip-dirs .uv-cache --skip-dirs dist --skip-dirs build --skip-dirs coverage .

steps.name: workflow-actionlint
steps.command: if compgen -G ".github/workflows/tooling-*.yml" > /dev/null; then actionlint .github/workflows/tooling-*.yml; elif compgen -G ".github/workflows/*.yml" > /dev/null; then actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml; else echo "no workflows detected"; fi

steps.name: workflow-zizmor
steps.command: if compgen -G ".github/workflows/tooling-*.yml" > /dev/null; then zizmor .github/workflows/tooling-*.yml; elif compgen -G ".github/workflows/*.yml" > /dev/null; then zizmor .github/workflows/*.yml; else echo "no workflows detected"; fi

steps.name: workflow-conftest
steps.command: if compgen -G ".github/workflows/tooling-*.yml" > /dev/null; then conftest test --all-namespaces -p tooling/policies/conftest/github-actions .github/workflows/tooling-*.yml; elif compgen -G ".github/workflows/*.yml" > /dev/null; then conftest test --all-namespaces -p tooling/policies/conftest/github-actions .github/workflows/*.yml; else echo "no workflows detected"; fi

steps.name: workflow-yamllint
steps.command: if compgen -G ".github/workflows/tooling-*.yml" > /dev/null; then yamllint -c tooling/configs/yamllint/yamllint.yaml .github/workflows/tooling-*.yml; elif compgen -G ".github/workflows/*.yml" > /dev/null; then yamllint -c tooling/configs/yamllint/yamllint.yaml .github/workflows/*.yml; else echo "no workflows detected"; fi

steps.name: semgrep
steps.command: semgrep scan --config auto --error --exclude artifacts --exclude archive --exclude _archive --exclude .data --exclude outputs --exclude packs --exclude node_modules --exclude .venv --exclude .pytest_cache --exclude .ruff_cache --exclude .mypy_cache --exclude .nox --exclude .tox --exclude build --exclude dist --exclude coverage .

steps.name: pip-audit
steps.command: if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then uv export --format requirements-txt --no-hashes > "{artifact_root}/python-requirements.txt" && pip-audit -r "{artifact_root}/python-requirements.txt" --no-deps --disable-pip; else echo "python dependency audit not applicable"; fi

steps.name: node-lockfile-audit-dev_tracker-ui
steps.command: if [ -f 'dev_tracker/ui/package-lock.json' ]; then cd 'dev_tracker/ui' && npm audit --audit-level=high; elif [ -f 'dev_tracker/ui/pnpm-lock.yaml' ]; then cd 'dev_tracker/ui' && audit_output=$(mktemp); if corepack pnpm audit --audit-level high >"$audit_output" 2>&1; then cat "$audit_output"; rm -f "$audit_output"; else audit_status=$?; cat "$audit_output" >&2; if grep -Eqi 'ERR_PNPM_AUDIT_BAD_RESPONSE|responded with 410|audit endpoint.*retir' "$audit_output"; then rm -f "$audit_output"; if command -v osv-scanner >/dev/null 2>&1; then osv-scanner scan source --lockfile pnpm-lock.yaml; else echo 'pnpm audit endpoint unavailable and osv-scanner is not installed' >&2; exit "$audit_status"; fi; else rm -f "$audit_output"; exit "$audit_status"; fi; fi; elif [ -f 'dev_tracker/ui/yarn.lock' ]; then cd 'dev_tracker/ui' && yarn npm audit --severity high; else echo 'node dependency audit not_applicable: no supported lockfile'; fi

steps.name: sonarqube-local
steps.command: if [ -z "${SONAR_HOST_URL:-}" ] || [ -z "${SONAR_TOKEN:-${SONAR_LOGIN:-}}" ]; then echo 'not_applicable: self-hosted SonarQube Community disabled; set SONAR_HOST_URL and SONAR_TOKEN locally'; exit 0; fi; if ! command -v sonar-scanner >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'unavailable: sonar-scanner missing for self-hosted SonarQube Community analysis'; exit 2; fi; sonar-scanner -Dsonar.host.url="${SONAR_HOST_URL}" -Dsonar.token="${SONAR_TOKEN:-${SONAR_LOGIN:-}}"
